messages.subject: Sutherland Logistics / Sterling — forbearance
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

We act for Sterling Commercial Bank. The Bank is willing to forbear in respect of the December covenant breaches while a consensual amendment is documented, subject to the usual conditions (good-faith engagement, information undertakings, no leakage, payment of the work fee and our costs). Forbearance to run to 30 June 2026 or completion, with the usual termination events.

We will send a draft forbearance letter shortly. The Bank's longstop for a deal is 31 July.

Regards,
Marcus Ashworth
Partner | Ashworth Quinn LLP

messages.subject: RE: Sutherland Logistics / Sterling — forbearance
messages.plaintextBody:
Marcus,

Thank you — a forbearance period to 30 June works and the conditions are broadly acceptable. Two points: (1) the fortnightly cashflow cadence is fine but weekly during March is onerous given the team's size — can we agree weekly only to the IBR delivery date, then fortnightly; and (2) please confirm the work fee figure so the client can arrange payment.

We'll turn the draft quickly.

Sarah
